clauses.clause: • Return target Zombie creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

mapping.notes: Choose(count 1): Finishing Blow's destroy; Rise Again's return with a Zombie creature card filter and tapped_on_enter. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: deadly_plot_returns_only_your_zombie_tapped, deadly_plot_destroys_a_planeswalker.

clauses.evidence: [cast modes=[0] targets=[...]] shows only 'X moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/DESTROY)'; [cast modes=[1] targets=['you_fallen']] shows only 'you_fallen moves graveyard -> battlefield (by card/MOVE_ZONE)': one mode per cast, and the other mode's effect never happens in the same variant. Pack D00_4 (passes): only the chosen mode needs a legal target (mode 1 casts with no creature or planeswalker anywhere, mode 0 casts with no Zombie in the graveyard). Packs D00_5 (passes): it is an instant, cast on the opponent's turn.

target slot (cast modes=[0]): 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]: every creature of both sides, no relic or charm; every variant ends 'X moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/DESTROY)' and 'X dies', and the spell goes to the graveyard.

The standard board has no planeswalker, so the slot above lists creatures only and nothing shows a planeswalker as a target or destroyed. Pack D00_1 (runpack passes): a planeswalker is a legal target and is destroyed; an artifact is refused as a target and stays.

clauses.clause: • Return target ... creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
clauses.evidence: target slot (cast modes=[1]): 1..1 of [you_fallen]: my own graveyard only (opp_fallen, the opponent's card, is not offered); events 'you_fallen moves graveyard -> battlefield (by card/MOVE_ZONE)' and 'you_fallen becomes tapped (by card/MOVE_ZONE)'; change 'you_fallen: zone graveyard -> battlefield; tapped False -> True; P/T - -> 2/2'.

clauses.clause: • Return target Zombie creature card (the Zombie restriction)
clauses.evidence: you_fallen is the only creature card in my graveyard and is itself the Zombie, so the slot [you_fallen] would read the same without the Zombie restriction. Pack D00_2 (runpack passes): a Bear creature card in my graveyard and the opponent's graveyard Zombie are both refused ('illegal target'); my Zombie returns tapped under my control and nothing else moves. Pack D00_3 (passes) adds a Zombie card that is not a creature card (a tribal sorcery): refused as a target.
